name: sandbox-runtime
notes: Forked from carderne/sandbox-runtime (itself derived from Anthropic's sandbox-runtime). The fork adds filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles so embedders can skip bwrap placeholder mounts for not-yet-existing dangerous files, and network.disabled so a session can run with all network policy enforcement off. Published locally as @xzzpig/sandbox-runtime: it is a support library for pi-sandbox rather than a Pi plugin, so this record keeps the plain upstream-derived name instead of the pi-* plugin convention.

knownDebt.reason: The fork deliberately pins TypeScript 5.6.3 while upstream uses ^5.6.3; widen only after a build compatibility check. The upstream-preserved npm lock still resolves 5.9.3, as it did before the v0.0.77 sync; the workspace pnpm lock governs the fork build.
Upstream's README carries a stray `<<<<<<< HEAD` line at column 0; the fork indents it two spaces because it sits inside a markdown list, and restoring column 0 fails the root `prettier --check`.

Seven line-length findings are unchanged in both the pre-sync fork and upstream v0.0.77; preserve the upstream release workflow under the current-change-only policy and revisit when upstream reformats it.

The optional test-wide TypeScript check reports 68 errors, exactly matching the pre-sync fork with the same toolchain; the package's source typecheck passes. Reconcile the upstream test types separately.

User accepted the reproduced host-specific verification exceptions for the v0.0.77 sync. On this NixOS/agent sandbox host seccomp observation emits no events because SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_NEW_LISTENER returns EBUSY; root-deny execution fails because bwrap cannot mount on the existing /sbin symlink; external proxy/SSH cases are intermittent or constrained. Observation, root-deny and network failures were reproduced on the pre-sync fork. Run the unchanged tests on a host with a free seccomp listener, compatible mount layout and network access.

reapplyOnSync: network.disabled, filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles, the readdirSync withFileTypes cast in sandbox-utils.ts, and the closeAllConnections cast in sandbox-manager.ts
keep src/sandbox/fork-network.ts (isNetworkDisabled) as the consolidated network.disabled precedence with its two sandbox-manager.ts call sites
keep pathEntryLstatExists exported (plus the root re-export) for the pi-sandbox fork, whose duplicate pathEntryExists was removed
keep the protectNonexistentFiles tests in fork-only test/sandbox/protect-nonexistent-files.test.ts

pass denyMandatoryCwdFiles and protectNonexistentFiles independently into linuxGetMandatoryDenyPaths; filter its deduplicated mandatory result through the fork-only mandatoryDenyFilter without filtering explicit denyWithinAllow paths; keep the pathEntryLstatExists re-export from linux-sandbox-utils.ts and the package root

keep the optional per-command cwd on ISandboxManager.wrapWithSandbox and its implementation, pass it through FsWriteRestrictionConfig to Linux mandatory scans and macOS mandatory static/glob rules, and forward the existing wrapWithSandboxArgv cwd into the string wrapper; omission still defaults to process.cwd without global chdir
doNotReintroduce: package-lock.json preserves upstream bytes and dependency entries except the two root name fields (@xzzpig/sandbox-runtime) and two root version fields (the independent fork package version), updated mechanically from the upstream lock
the exact typescript 5.6.3 pin is deliberate — do not widen it without a build check
